about.heading: Meet Vibe.
about.subtitle: The most beautiful way to manage, organize, and listen to your personal music collection.
about.p1: Vibe is an open-source, modern music player built from the ground up for performance and aesthetic purity. Powered by Vue 3, Vite, and Appwrite, it offers a seamless and highly responsive audio experience.
about.p2: Whether you are uploading a vast library of genres or casually streaming a few favorites, Vibe's custom-built audio engine guarantees gapless transitions, intelligent network caching, and perfect sync across your devices.
about.p3: Design is at the core of everything we do. We stripped away the bulky complexity of traditional media managers to leave behind exactly what matters: your music.
